notes.title: Behind The NSOM Music - Episode 1
notes.notes:
Feel free to check out the first episode of the "Behind The Music" series created by the game's composer in which he goes in depth into how he made the spooky music heard throughout the game!

notes.title: No Son Of Mine is Out NOW!
notes.notes:
No Son Of Mine is officially out and available for purchase. 
Enjoy, and good luck!

notes.title: It's Almost Time...
notes.notes:
I'd like to thank everyone for your patience. No Son Of Mine will be releasing very, very soon. I wish you all the best of luck in surviving the game.

In the mean time I would strongly suggest everyone tune in to Feardemic's Fear Fest event on September 6th, hosted by IGN. Something cool might happen if you do...

[url=https://fearfest.online/]Fear Fest 2023[/url]
